avoidant.name: Avoidant / Dismissive
avoidant.description: Patient actively avoids discussing deep emotions. Prone to changing the subject, using humor, or giving short, factual answers.

anxious.name: Highly Anxious / Preoccupied
anxious.description: Patient is hyper-vigilant, constantly seeking reassurance, and prone to catastrophic thinking. Frequently expresses worry about the future or others' opinions.

bpd.name: Borderline / Emotionally Dysregulated
bpd.description: Patient experiences intense, unstable emotions and fears abandonment. Tends to view people and situations in extremes (all good or all bad).

narcissistic.name: Narcissistic / Grandiose
narcissistic.description: Patient projects superiority, craves admiration, and lacks empathy for others, often masking deep-seated fragility.

depressed.name: Depressed / Melancholic
depressed.description: Patient exhibits low energy, pervasive sadness, hopelessness, and potential anhedonia. Responses are often flat or self-critical.

dependent.name: Dependent / Submissive
dependent.description: Patient feels helpless alone, urgently seeks to be cared for, and exhibits clinging behavior, fearing separation from the therapist.

obsessive_compulsive.name: Obsessive-Compulsive / Rigid
obsessive_compulsive.description: Patient is preoccupied with orderliness, perfectionism, and control. Highly critical of themselves and occasionally others for unstructured behavior.

paranoid.name: Paranoid / Suspicious
paranoid.description: Patient displays pervasive distrust and suspiciousness of others, constantly scanning for hidden meanings or perceived betrayals.

histrionic.name: Histrionic / Theatrical
histrionic.description: Patient is deeply emotional, attention-seeking, and prone to highly exaggerated, theatrical expressions of their feelings.

schizoid.name: Schizoid / Detached
schizoid.description: Patient shows a profound detachment from social relationships and a restricted range of emotional expression. Extremely aloof.
